patch.value: Agent skills instruct flags and spellings the runtime refuses, and no guide topic routes the evidence or automation families

Measured 2026-09-04 against the 2026.9.4 build across all 12 SKILL.md files and 16 references (93 KB).

Instructions the runtime refuses or misroutes: the pm-user WORKFLOWS reference instructs --allow-audit-comment and --allow-audit-dep-update without naming the governance-audit package that provides them, so on a bare install both are unknown options; the pm-extensions skill and its LIFECYCLE reference instruct pm package manage --detail summary at three sites while --detail belongs to package doctor; the TROUBLESHOOTING reference and HARNESS_COMPATIBILITY instruct the deprecated pm extension and pm install spellings inside numbered lists, which the fence-only deprecated-spelling scan cannot see; the Codex native skill shows author: codex-agent in its canonical argument shape two screens above the sentence forbidding it.

Routing that does not exist: no skill or reference names pm learnings, and none of the 13 guide topics names learnings, history-repair, history-redact, history-compact, history-author-acknowledge, close-many, reindex, or test-all. Measured per declared capability family, the evidence family (12 commands) and the automation family (3) are reachable only through the generated capabilities listing, which has no workflow. Nine files carry a hand-maintained literal "Guide topics:" list that already omits the capabilities topic the runtime declares.

Root cause is the gate denominator: the docs-skills gate proves every guide topic names real commands, never that every capability family has a workflow topic, and never that an instructed flag exists. Acceptance: the gate derives the family set from PM_COMMAND_CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS and fails when a family has no non-generated topic (negative control proven); the gate validates every --flag in a fenced skill invocation against the core contract, the global flags, and package-declared flags (negative control proven); evidence and automation guide topics exist with workflows and docs; no agent-facing file carries a literal topic list; every corrected instruction was executed against the built CLI.

The docs-skills gate derives the family set from PM_COMMAND_CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS and fails when any family has no non-generated guide topic, with a proven negative control; The docs-skills gate validates every --flag in a fenced skill invocation against the core contract, the global flags, and package-declared flags, with a proven negative control; evidence and automation guide topics exist with workflows and docs and the merge topic names reconcile and report; No agent-facing skill or README carries a hand-maintained literal guide topic list and every corrected instruction was executed against the built CLI

Run pm package manage --detail summary, pm comments <id> --add x --allow-audit-comment on a bare install, grep learnings across .agents/skills and plugins, and compare guide topic commands against PM_COMMAND_CAPABILITY_CONTRACTS families
Every instructed flag and spelling executes on the build that ships the skill and every capability family has a workflow topic
Three instructed flags are refused on a bare install, two deprecated spellings are instructed outside fences, learnings appears nowhere, and evidence plus automation have no workflow topic

patch.value: All 12 skills and 16 references pass the fenced-flag and deprecated-spelling checks, 9 of 9 capability families route through a non-generated topic, and guide learnings, record, and calendar resolve to the new topics
Every fenced instruction in a skill executes on the build that ships it and every declared capability family is routed by a workflow topic
